changelog: Fixed a game crash when hovering an NPC or a player in Cursor mode.
New Cursor mode: press Alt to free your mouse, aim at anything and click to interact.
Works with every existing ox_target interaction (entities, models, zones, bones, groups, items, submenus).
Built-in context actions on the sky, ground, players, NPCs, vehicles and objects, with server-checked staff tools (weather, time, teleport, heal, revive, repair, delete...).
/targetui now opens a small menu to pick between Classic, ACN and Cursor modes.
